meteorological--adj.def: Relating to the weather and its study.
meteorological--adj.ex: Meteorological data shows a warm decade.
meteorological--adj.exTr: Meteorolojik veriler sıcak bir on yılı gösteriyor.

divination--noun.def: The practice of seeking knowledge of the future by magic.

virginal--adj.def: Pure and untouched, as if never used before.
virginal--adj.exTr: Tarlayı el değmemiş bir kar örtüsü kaplamıştı.

confrontational--adj.def: Behaving in a way that invites argument or conflict.
confrontational--adj.ex: His confrontational style lost him allies.

thicket--noun.def: A dense group of bushes and small trees.
thicket--noun.ex: The fox vanished into the thicket.

glitz--noun.def: Showy attractiveness that has little depth.
glitz--noun.ex: The awards night was all glitz.

impresario--noun.def: A person who organises concerts, operas or shows.
impresario--noun.ex: A famous impresario booked the hall.

stipulate--verb.def: To state clearly that something must be done.

melodious--adj.def: Pleasant to listen to, like a tune.
melodious--adj.ex: A melodious voice filled the room.

allegory--noun.def: A story whose characters stand for wider ideas.
allegory--noun.ex: The play is an allegory of greed.

plumage--noun.def: All the feathers covering a bird.

palatable--adj.def: Pleasant enough to eat, or acceptable to the mind.

topography--noun.def: The shape and features of the surface of land.

remit--verb.def: To send money, or to pass a matter to another authority.

materialism--noun.def: The belief that possessions matter more than ideas or spirit.

assimilation--noun.def: The taking in of information, or becoming part of a society.

malleable--adj.def: Easy to shape, said of metal or of a person's opinions.

monastic--adj.def: Relating to monks, or very simple and disciplined.

unequivocally--adv.tr: kesin olarak, hiçbir kuşkuya yer bırakmadan
unequivocally--adv.def: In a way that leaves no room for doubt.

wheeze--verb.def: To breathe with a rough whistling sound.

habitation--noun.def: The act of living in a place, or a place to live.
habitation--noun.ex: The hut is unfit for habitation.

bauble--noun.def: A cheap showy ornament of little value.
bauble--noun.ex: The tree was hung with baubles.

dampen--verb.def: To make a feeling weaker, or to make something slightly wet.
dampen--verb.ex: Rain did not dampen their mood.

ostensibly--adv.def: According to what is claimed, though perhaps untrue.
ostensibly--adv.ex: He left ostensibly for health reasons.

loiter--verb.def: To stand or move slowly in a place with no purpose.
loiter--verb.ex: Do not loiter by the gate.

laryngitis--noun.def: An inflammation of the throat that takes away the voice.

electrode--noun.def: A small piece of metal that carries current into something.
electrode--noun.ex: Attach the electrode to the skin.

milieu--noun.def: The social surroundings in which someone lives.
milieu--noun.ex: He never left his own milieu.

mercantile--adj.ex: The city grew on mercantile wealth.

pervasive--adj.def: Present everywhere in a place or system.

preoccupation--noun.def: A subject that fills someone's thoughts.

zoology--noun.ex: She teaches zoology at the university.

acrobatics--noun.def: Difficult jumps and balances performed as a skill.

intrinsic--adj.def: Belonging naturally to something as part of its nature.

attuned--adj.def: Able to notice and respond to something sensitively.
attuned--adj.ex: She is attuned to their moods.

oblique--adj.def: Not direct in expression, or slanting in direction.
oblique--adj.ex: He made an oblique reference to it.

wistful--adj.def: Sadly longing for something lost or unreachable.

drudgery--noun.def: Hard boring work that must be repeated.
drudgery--noun.ex: Machines removed much of the drudgery.

archetype--noun.def: A perfect example after which others are modelled.
archetype--noun.ex: He is the archetype of a detective.

abhorrent--adj.ex: Such cruelty is abhorrent to us.
abhorrent--adj.exTr: Böyle bir zulüm bize iğrenç geliyor.

proximal--adj.def: Nearer to the centre of the body or to a point of attachment.
proximal--adj.ex: The break is at the proximal end.

philanthropic--adj.def: Concerned with giving money and help to others.
philanthropic--adj.ex: A philanthropic trust owns the land.

maliciously--adv.def: With the deliberate aim of causing harm.

torrential--adj.def: Falling in very large amounts, said of rain.

elasticity--noun.def: The ability of a material to stretch and return to shape.

cull--verb.def: To select items from a larger set, or to kill weak animals.
cull--verb.ex: Facts were culled from old files.

counterproductive--adj.def: Having the opposite effect to the one intended.

painstakingly--adv.def: With very careful and slow attention.

fallacy--noun.def: A belief that many hold but that is false.

haphazard--adj.ex: The files were stored in haphazard piles.

surrealist--noun.def: An artist who shows dreamlike images beyond ordinary reality.

vindication--noun.def: Proof that someone was right or free of blame.

edifice--noun.def: A large impressive building, or a large system of ideas.
edifice--noun.ex: A stone edifice dominates the square.

etch--verb.def: To cut lines into a hard surface, or to fix firmly in memory.
etch--verb.ex: The date is etched in the stone.

ethos--noun.def: The guiding beliefs and character of a group.
ethos--noun.ex: The school has a caring ethos.

maelstrom--noun.def: A violent whirlpool, or a confused and turbulent situation.
maelstrom--noun.ex: The country fell into a maelstrom.

burgeoning--adj.exTr: Onları hızla büyüyen bir pazar bekliyor.

irrevocably--adv.def: In a way that cannot be changed afterwards.

facsimile--noun.def: An exact copy of a document or picture.

wane--verb.def: To become gradually smaller or weaker.

minster--noun.def: A large church, often one attached to a monastery.
minster--noun.ex: The minster bells rang at noon.

attrition--noun.def: A gradual wearing down through steady loss.
attrition--noun.ex: The war became one of attrition.

buccaneer--verb.def: To sail as a pirate and attack ships for plunder.

buccaneer--noun.def: A pirate, especially one of the Caribbean seas.

stipulation--noun.def: A condition that must be met in an agreement.

subsidize--verb.def: To pay part of the cost so that prices stay low.

jarring--adj.def: Unpleasantly out of place or shocking.

unadulterated--adj.def: Pure, with nothing else mixed in.

disparaging--adj.def: Suggesting that someone or something has little worth.

sandwiched--adj.def: Pressed tightly between two other things.
sandwiched--adj.ex: The shop is sandwiched between two banks.

denote--verb.def: To be a sign of something, or to mean it.

contractual--adj.def: Agreed in and required by a contract.
contractual--adj.ex: We have a contractual duty to pay.
contractual--adj.exTr: Ödeme yapmak sözleşmeden doğan bir yükümlülüğümüz.

paradoxical--adj.def: Seeming to contradict itself while still being true.
paradoxical--adj.ex: The result is paradoxical but real.
